protocol: Percentile picks by realized return among tape-dense trades (>=60 prints in window), plus best COVID-2020 entry and a median stale hard-stop loser. Not cherry-picked.

trades.label: 90th-percentile outcome
trades.note: A deep forced-seller dislocation that fully reverts — the strategy's target trade.

trades.label: Median outcome
trades.note: The typical trade: modest dislocation, recovery to the pre-event median, exit at the first qualifying bid.

trades.label: COVID 2020 entry
trades.note: Crisis vintage: the March-2020 liquidation priced short-dated credit for defaults that never came.

trades.label: 10th-percentile outcome
trades.note: A loser: the dislocation was information, not flow — the price kept sliding and the exit realized a loss.

trades.label: Hard-stop stale exit
trades.note: The failure mode the engine never hides: the bond stopped trading and the position exits at the last available bid.
